spec.description: AngelStep is an Australian designed and manufactured acoustic underlay range engineered to enhance the acoustic performance of residential and commercial flooring [2]. Its construction combines impact vibration damping and sound absorption with decoupled noise barrier technology to minimise airborne and footfall noise [2]. Free from glues and binding agents, its double-needling process guarantees uniform resilience throughout the lifetime of the floor [2].
features: Outstanding acoustic performance (consistently achieves AAAC 5 and 6 stars) [2]
No glues or binding agents used; fibres held by double-needling process [2]
Polyester will not degrade or breakdown over time [2]
Vibration damping absorber made from 75% recycled material [2]
Will last the life of the flooring material [2]
applications: under solid timber, engineered timber and laminate flooring [2]
spec.fire: AS ISO 9705-2003 Group 1; SMOGRArc < 100 m²/s² as required by BCA C1.10 (BRANZ FI 4871); ISO 9705:1993 Group 1-S [2]
spec.compliance: Building Code of Australia (BCA) / NCC compliant for separating floors; AS ISO 9705-2003; ISO 16283-1:2014; AAAC Star Rating System [2]
spec.sustainability: Zero VOCs, zero emissions, non-toxic; Cetec tested VOC concentration 0.01 mg/m³; absorber made from 75% recycled material [2]
install: Ensure concrete slab is flat with no more than +/- 3mm deviation in a 3m radius as per AS 3600:2001 [2]
Subfloor surface must be clean, dry and completely free of debris [2]
Fix any existing squeaks in timber floors prior to installation [2]
Install 40mm x (AngelStep thickness - 1mm) MDF battens around perimeter of room for smooth edge grip installation if carpeting [2]
Install AngelStep tiles tightly butted together [2]
Joins may be taped using aluminium tape if necessary to ensure zero gaps between sheets [2]
Spot glue AngelStep using a polyurethane-based flooring adhesive (e.g. Bostik Ultraset SF, Sika T-55J, Mapei Ultrabond P990) [2]
Leave a 3-5mm expansion gap between walls and finished floor surface [2]
Install skirting after flooring, maintaining a 3mm gap between floor finish and skirting [2]
Cut tiles neatly using a sharp Stanley knife [2]
selection_checklist: Identify subfloor structure (concrete slab vs timber joists) [2]
Identify final floor finish (tile, timber, vinyl, or carpet) [2]
Verify strata by-laws / body corporate acoustic target (BCA minimum vs AAAC 5 or 6 stars) [2]
Check subfloor flatness conforms to AS 3600:2001 (+/- 3mm over 3m) [2]
accessories: Polyurethane-based flooring adhesive (Bostik Ultraset SF, Sika T-55J, Mapei Ultrabond P990) [2]
limitations: Do not mechanically fix through AngelStep [2]
Do not use Modified Silicone Polymer adhesives [2]
Subfloor deviation must not exceed +/- 3mm in a 3m radius without levelling compound [2]
Must not be subject to maximum intermittent temperatures equal to or exceeding 60°C [2]
spec.warranty: 10 years / will last the life of the flooring material [2]

use_cases: installing under engineered timber or hybrid flooring in multi-storey apartments to achieve AAAC 5 or 6 stars
decoupling ceramic and stone tiles over concrete slabs to prevent impact noise transmission
retrofitting under carpet and vinyl in townhouses and luxury residences to silence footfall noise
meeting strict body corporate impact sound criteria during apartment floor renovations
retrieval.rag_summary: Acoustica AngelStep is a premium Australian-designed and manufactured acoustic flooring underlay engineered to control impact footfall and airborne noise transmission under timber, laminate, ceramic tiles, vinyl, and carpet. Constructed from double-needled resilient polyester without glues or binding agents and incorporating recycled damping materials, it achieves up to AAAC 6 Star acoustic performance and Group 1 fire classification. It is primarily installed over concrete slabs and timber subfloors in apartments, multi-residential dwellings, and commercial suites to satisfy stringent strata and NCC acoustic regulations.
